topics.label: Introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture structure, learning outcomes, and the conceptual framework of the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and mutational deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase and Wnt/beta-catenin pathways enable cancer cells to sustain autonomous proliferative signaling and evade growth suppression.

topics.label: Blocks to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how malignancies in both hematopoietic and epithelial tissues arrest cells in immature, proliferative states rather than allowing terminal differentiation.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the molecular mechanisms by which cancer cells resist programmed cell death through p53 pathway inactivation and Bcl-2 family imbalance.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and stress barriers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor cells overcome replicative limits and telomere shortening while bypassing p53-mediated stress responses and senescence, concluding the overview of cell-autonomous growth hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how tumor cells alter cellular metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific rewiring, and Krebs cycle mutations that produce oncogenic metabolites.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the mechanisms by which developing tumors trigger blood vessel recruitment to satisfy oxygen and nutrient demands.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the biological cascade of metastatic dissemination, the selective barriers encountered during spread, methods for clinical monitoring, and associated genomic features.

topics.label: Conclusion and summary of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides final summarizing perspectives on cancer hallmark acquisition and concludes the lecture with closing remarks.
